name: Vanthorpe Analyst Wristframe Mark III
description:
A slim wrist device worn by Tier 3 desk workers who want something smarter than the standard-issue Helix Corp band but can't justify Tier 4 hardware. Brushed titanium-analog casing in warm gunmetal, paired with a modular strap in dark oxblood synthetic leather. The face is a flush micro-OLED display that reads analog-style by default — switchable to full data overlay.

Port access sits at the inner wrist edge, compatible with standard BCI handshake protocols. The device runs calendar, biometric, transit credentials, and ambient comms on a single charge lasting 72 hours. Understated enough to pass in Tier 3 without triggering status anxiety.
functionality: Runs calendar, biometric monitoring, transit credentials, ambient comms, and BCI handshake. 72-hour battery. Modular strap system allows quick swap. Analog display mode reduces social friction in mixed-tier environments.
what_it_says: You've invested in capability without broadcasting ambition — you're smarter than your floor suggests.
story_hooks: The Mark III has an undocumented passive data-logging feature that Vanthorpe uses for behavioral profiling — a whistleblower just went public.
A wearer's biometric logs show they were somewhere they claimed not to be — someone is using that data as leverage.
A street tech offers to unlock the device's full hardware capability for Φ40 cash — the offer sounds too good to be legitimate.
related_entities: NeuralPath CivID Plus Identity & Payment BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sophisticated wrist-worn device that bridges professional minimalism with subtle tech prestige. The flush face sits nearly level with the wrist, creating a sleek, integrated appearance. The warm gunmetal casing catches light with a brushed, non-reflective finish that reads as intentionally understated—expensive restraint rather than chrome flash.
physical_description.fit: Snug but not restrictive—designed for all-day wear under dress sleeves or visible on casual Tier 3 workwear. The modular strap system allows micro-adjustments; sits flush against the wrist bone without tension.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium-analog casing with dark oxblood synthetic leather modular strap. The strap has subtle cross-grain texture mimicking genuine leather without the fragility.
physical_description.texture: Casing is matte with micro-brushed finish—warm to the touch, slightly grippy. Strap is smooth on the outer surface with a soft suede-like inner face against skin. Display is perfectly flush, uninterrupted glass.
physical_description.color_scheme: Warm gunmetal gray (#5a5a5a tones) casing paired with deep oxblood burgundy (#4a1a1a) strap. Micro-OLED face glows soft amber when displaying analog mode, sharp white when in data overlay.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap connections on the strap ends—quick-release modular system. No visible buckles or holes; the strap segments simply click into recessed ports on either side of the casing.
distinctive_features: Flush micro-OLED display (analog dial default, toggles to full UI overlay)
Inner-wrist BCI port with standard handshake protocol compatibility
Vanthorpe Systems branding as subtle engraved mark on 6 o'clock position
Subtle beveled edge around casing perimeter
72-hour battery indicator visible only in data mode
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 professional aspirational—visible enough to signal competence and access to mid-grade corporate infrastructure, subtle enough not to provoke resentment in peer groups.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by desk workers, logistics coordinators, and mid-level corpo staff who interface between field ops and management. Signals reliable, connected professionalism without flash. Common in GLMZ administrative hubs and finance districts.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually pristine to lightly worn—occasional micro-scratches on the casing from daily contact with desk edges. Strap may show subtle creasing from repeated folding. Display remains protected by gorilla glass; no visible wear on face.
